_howto: Guided setup for Contractors & Distribution (Demo / Setup mode).
title: Set up Contractors
intro: Work through these in order. You're in demo, so nothing affects your live system until you push it.

steps.title: Currency, rules, seasons and tobacco types
steps.why: The currency, when inputs may be given, your seasons and what farmers grow.

steps.title: Locations
steps.why: The areas farmers belong to. Everything is filtered and approved by area.

steps.title: Hierarchy and managers
steps.why: Your structure and who manages each part, so approvals go to the right people.

steps.title: Approval workflow
steps.why: Who approves contracts and distributions, per level.

steps.title: Warehouses, stock items and a cycle
steps.why: Where inputs are kept, what they are, and the distribution cycle they are given out in.

steps.title: Farmers
steps.why: Add farmers one by one or import them.

steps.title: Test run
steps.why:
Prove it works, all in demo:
  1. Give a farmer a contract, and approve it in the Inbox.
  2. Receive stock into a warehouse (GRV) and give the farmer inputs.
  3. See it in Progress and a report.
Contracts, stock and distributions are never pushed to live.
